product_one_liner.value: Disprz is an AI-powered learning and skilling platform combining LMS, LXP, and AI content authoring to help enterprises build workforce capability across employees and frontline teams.

pricing_page.notes: Lists Essentials pricing from $2 per learner/month and custom-priced Enterprise plans.

named_customers.notes: All names appear in the case-studies page/company homepage customer examples.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies West Orange, New Jersey as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Company LinkedIn profile states founded in 2015.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog index is predominantly learning, product and marketing content; no qualifying set of engineering/product-build posts appears.

public_docs.notes: Homepage surfaces an FAQ and support email, but no public product docs/help center or developer portal with several articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Could not locate an accessible current Disprz careers page or job board to verify open roles.

model_provider.notes: Public product/blog/security searches did not disclose a named foundation-model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Trust Vault publicly states ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. GDPR is described as a privacy framework, not included as a certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent identified round is the August 2023 Series C, outside the 18-month period before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No current company careers/job board could be verified.

launched_6mo.notes: Autonomous Enablement OS launch announcement dated 2026-09-28 falls within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No reliably inspectable full team page or dated executive join/departure evidence was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Available public product/case-study pages reviewed did not name a CRM or sales/marketing system as one Disprz visibly uses.
